# Ask Away Blog

> > A personal lifestyle blog by Ellen Ross covering practical guidance on personal finance, home improvement, organization, and everyday living.

Ask Away Blog is a comprehensive lifestyle resource created by Ellen Ross, featuring in-depth guides on budgeting, debt payoff, home decor, kitchen remodeling, and organization systems like the KonMari Method. The blog combines personal experience with actionable advice and free downloadable tools to help readers improve their finances and home environments.

## Key Topics

- Personal Finance
- Debt Payoff
- Budgeting Systems
- Home Improvement
- Kitchen Remodel
- Interior Design
- KonMari Method
- Minimalism
- Storage Solutions
- Home Management
- Curb Appeal
- Financial Planning
- Money Management
- Downsizing
- Home Fire Safety

## Personal Finance & Budgeting

- [My Guide to Being on a Budget](http://www.askawayblog.com/2013/06/my-guide-to-being-on-budget.html): Budgeting guide for creating useable budget systems with Filofax
- [A Look at My Filofax Budget Envelope System](http://www.askawayblog.com/2014/02/a-look-at-my-filofax-budget-envelope.html): Step-by-step cash envelope budgeting system setup and usage tutorial
- [Downloadable Budgeting Spreadsheets](http://www.askawayblog.com/2015/10/downloadable-budgeting-spreadsheets.html): Free downloadable budget and debt payoff tracking spreadsheet templates
- [How To Get Out of Debt (From Someone Who Has Done It)](https://www.askawayblog.com/2018/09/how-to-get-out-of-debt-from-someone-who.html): Debt payoff guide covering emergency funds, budgeting, and debt planning
- [Bride On A Budget: How We Got Married for Under $2,500](http://www.askawayblog.com/2017/11/bride-on-budget-how-we-got-married-for.html): Budget wedding planning guide with cost breakdown and DIY tips

## Home Organization & Decluttering

- [The Ultimate KonMari Decluttering + Tidying Checklist | FREE PRINTABLE](https://www.askawayblog.com/2019/02/the-ultimate-konmari-decluttering.html): KonMari Method guide with free printable decluttering checklist by Marie Kondo
- [Get Your FREE PRINTABLE Home Management Binder Today!](https://www.askawayblog.com/2019/01/get-your-free-printable-home-management.html): Free printable home management binder with meal planning and scheduling
- [Simplifying Your Life: The Stress-Relief Benefits of Downsizing Your Home](https://www.askawayblog.com/2026/03/simplifying-your-life-stress-relief.html): Guide on downsizing benefits for stress relief and financial wellness

## Home Improvement & Design

- [Enhancing Curb Appeal with Fences and Landscaping](https://www.askawayblog.com/2026/03/enhancing-curb-appeal-with-fences-and.html): Curb appeal guide covering fencing and landscaping for home exterior
- [Essential Home Fire Safety Tips Every Homeowner Should Know](https://www.askawayblog.com/2026/03/essential-home-fire-safety-tips-every.html): Home fire safety guide with tips from National Fire Protection Association
